name: Jesus
note: From Nazareth in Galilee. Matthew presents him as the Messiah from David's line, and as "God with us."

name: Mary
note: Engaged to Joseph when she is found to be pregnant. Matthew tells the birth story from Joseph's side.

name: Joseph
note: Mary's husband, from David's line. Guided by dreams, he protects the child and his mother.

name: Herod the Great
note: Rome's client king over Judea. A great builder, and ruthless toward anyone who threatened his throne.

name: The magi
note: Visitors from the east who read the stars and come to honor a newborn king. Matthew doesn't say how many there were.

name: Archelaus
note: Herod's son who ruled Judea after him, harshly enough that Rome later removed him.

name: John the Baptist
note: A prophet in the wilderness who calls people to repent and baptizes them in the Jordan.

name: Scribes, Pharisees, and Sadducees
note: Leading groups in Judaism. Scribes were experts in the law; Pharisees taught careful keeping of it; Sadducees were tied to the priests and the temple.

name: The devil
note: The tempter, who tests Jesus in the wilderness.

name: Simon Peter
note: A fisherman from Galilee, the first disciple called and the most prominent of the twelve.

name: James
note: Son of Zebedee, called with his brother John from their father's boat.

name: John
note: Son of Zebedee and brother of James.

name: Tamar, Rahab, Ruth, and "Uriah's wife"
note: Four women named in Jesus' family line, each with an unusual story. Ruth is the Ruth whose book we studied.

name: The disciples
note: Jesus' followers, starting with the four fishermen. Later, the twelve.

name: The crowds
note: Ordinary people from Galilee, Judea, and beyond who follow Jesus to listen and be healed.

name: Solomon
note: David's son, Israel's wealthiest and wisest king.
